name: 道の駅 かみみね
desc: 佐賀県上峰町の国道34号線沿いにある、県内最大級の広さを誇る「道の駅 かみみね」。明るく開放的な直売所には、朝採れの新鮮な野菜や果物、お肉や魚介、バラエティ豊かなお惣菜がずらりと並びます。さらに、県内各地のこだわりプリンの食べ比べができるコーナーや、人気店の絶品グルメが揃うフードコートも充実。お買い物からグルメまで、家族みんなで存分に楽しめる新しい魅力が詰まったスポットです。
descEn: Located along National Route 34 in Kamimine Town, "Michi-no-Eki Kamimine" is one of the largest roadside stations in Saga Prefecture. The bright and spacious direct sales market offers an abundant selection of freshly harvested vegetables and fruits, high-quality meats, seafood, and delicious side dishes. Visitors can also enjoy a special pudding-tasting corner featuring treats from across the prefecture and a vibrant food court with popular local gourmet eateries. It is a fantastic destination where families can enjoy everything from shopping to exceptional local cuisine.
